Tiles are 160 px tall in a 10-column grid. Tile 00 is the Thatcher style anchor, then 01-18 for people with several portraits, 19-42 for single portraits, and 43-46 for the fictional people.

**(1) House style**
- **Background and framing: pass.** Measured backgrounds are RGB 13-19 / 39-46 / 48-55, with border std about 1.0 (the anchor is 21,40,48). Every portrait is an opaque, flat dark teal, including the corrected crown-prince-2030-v2. All 46 are full-body and centred (centre x 46-51%). The figure fills 90.6-94.6% of the height, with top margins of 2.1-4.4% and bottom margins of 2.6-5.3%. Heads and shoes are never cropped.
- **Proportions: systematic deviation.** The Tonga prompts ask for "adult 5.5-head proportions". Measured with guide lines, the results are:

  | Set | Height in heads |
  |---|---|
  | Thatcher anchor | about 4.2 |
  | Other-country samples (Kohl, Major, Cameron, Lupi, Buthelezi, fictional-japan-ldp-01) | about 5-5.5 |
  | 42 historical Tonga portraits | about 6.5-7.5 |
  | 4 fictional Tonga portraits | about 6.3-6.5 |

  The whole Tonga cast is more naturalistic than the anchor and the other countries. Faces are smaller on full-body cards. The main-menu cover crop (object-position 50% 12%) offsets this partly.
